title: Business Analysis as a state of mind

video_thumbnail.alt: Business Analysis as a state of mind by Wiktoria Gromowa-Cieślik

blocks.html:
Conducting our daily work we most probably don't think about the genesis of outputs we get. I caught myself (being at the point, when quick and thoughtful decision required) saying: "ok, let me now do my usual business analysis work and I will get back with the proposition". And that was happening, when I was already on leadership positions.

So, what was so different between output I was getting without business analysis work done and with it? During my presentation I will share my observations about special thinking used to provide good analysis, examples from real life and business world. I will try to answer the question, why business analysis mindset might be something, we would desire the most to possess in future?
